_comment: Why a figure the hub shows is absent from the XBRL feed (SEC companyfacts API), one record per company × metric, written after reading the filing or its XBRL (owner's third review, 2026-10-03). result: none = the line does not exist for this company (no such instrument or activity); text = the figure is in the filing text and is shown from it (amountUSDm, src with page and quote, checked by build.mjs against the harvested page); fy_only / ytd_only = tagged only in the annual report / as a year-to-date figure (amountUSDm, period); custom_tag = the company tags the line with a company-specific concept the API does not serve; not_disclosed = searched in the filing (EDGAR full-text search of the primary document, or the harvested text) and absent; unknown = not tagged and not yet resolved (stays 'not tagged' on the page). evidence: what was checked (XBRL companyfacts concepts, EDGAR full-text search hits, harvested page). A cell with a record is shown as an explained gap, never as 'not tagged' without a reason. Metrics follow scripts/hyperscalers/tags.mjs. Amounts in US$ millions. reviewedBy stays null until a person signs off. result last_tagged = the company stopped tagging the concept (the latest fact is shown with its date; no later figure exists). derived = a trailing-twelve-month figure built from tagged facts plus periods whose cash-flow statement carries no such line (listed in zeroPeriods and read as zero: a complete statement omits a line only when it is nil), with every input's accession; rendered as 'derived' with the method in the ⓘ card and counted as a value present (FNAM calculation), never as quote-matched.
